name: Fingerprint
description:
The Fingerprint MCP Server connects Claude directly to Fingerprint's device intelligence platform, enabling fraud analysts, developers, and security teams to investigate suspicious activity and understand traffic patterns more quickly.

Fingerprint captures device intelligence signals, including bot detection, VPN usage, browser tampering, and visitor behavior, on your highest-risk pages and actions like login, checkout, and account creation. With this connector, you can query that data conversationally, no dashboards or manual correlation required

Try prompts like:

- "Show me bot traffic from the last hour."
- "Is this signup spike part of a coordinated operation?"
- "Who are my most suspicious visitors and why?"
- "Help me implement Fingerprint to protect my site."

Claude queries your Fingerprint workspace and returns insights in seconds. Developers can also use it to build and integrate Fingerprint into their applications, getting guidance on setup, configuration, and best practices without leaving the conversation.

Connect to your Fingerprint account to get started. New to Fingerprint? Sign up for free at fingerprint.com.

_published_faq.name: How do I add Fingerprint to Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor?

acceptedAnswer.text: Add Fingerprint to Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor by connecting its remote MCP URL in each client's MCP settings. In Claude, add a custom connector. In ChatGPT, add an MCP app. In Cursor, add an MCP server under Settings. The MCP URL is https://mcp.fpjs.io/mcp. This server requires OAuth, so complete the login prompt after you connect.

_published_faq.name: What tools does the Fingerprint MCP server provide?

acceptedAnswer.text: Fingerprint provides these MCP tools: create_api_key, create_environment, get_api_key, get_current_time, get_event, list_api_keys, list_environments, search_events, update_api_key, and update_environment.

_published_faq.name: What are the best alternatives to Fingerprint?

acceptedAnswer.text: As of October 17, 2026, alternatives to Fingerprint in data-analytics on the Manufact MCP catalog include Epicure, Newsflash, Point Topic, Pricing Optimizer AI, and StatCite.
Fingerprint requires authentication. Connect it in Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor and complete the OAuth login prompt.
Fingerprint is developed by Fingerprint. It is listed as community on the Claude connector directory.
